description: This file defines functions to generate and register PyTorch operator tests and gradient tests based on provided configurations and operator lists. It serves as a test case generator and coordinator for benchmarking PyTorch operators, integrating with other modules for registration and test case creation.

methods.name: generate_pt_test(configs, pt_bench_op)
methods.description: Creates a single PyTorch operator test based on given configurations and operator.

methods.name: generate_pt_gradient_test(configs, pt_bench_op)
methods.description: Creates a gradient test for a PyTorch operator based on given configurations and operator.

methods.name: generate_pt_tests_from_op_list(ops_list, configs, pt_bench_op)
methods.description: Generates multiple PyTorch operator tests from a list of operators with specified configurations.

methods.name: generate_pt_gradient_tests_from_op_list(ops_list, configs, pt_bench_op)
methods.description: Generates multiple gradient tests from a list of operators with specified configurations.
